title: Even though it was raining, I still had lots of fun!
scene: 下雨还跑出去玩，回来爸爸数落。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You went outside in the rain?!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Even though it was raining, I still had lots of fun!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But you're all wet, from head to toe!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Even though my shoes got wet, I still jumped in every puddle!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: A little, but the puddles were so splashy!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You'll catch a cold, silly tiger. Towel time — now.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Okay! Drying fast, so no cold can catch me!
